overview: The Grand Resonance Core is the primary void‑arcane engine of Ka Vethan, stabilizing the city’s rituals, infrastructure, and Praesertum governance.
history: Constructed by early Akhevan architects to harness Luclinite resonance.
Void‑arcane conduits were added to distribute energy across Ka Vethan.
Stabilizer rings were installed after the first resonance cascade.
Praesertum decrees formalized the Core as a sacred civic structure.
Modern Core remains the most powerful arcane engine on Luclin.
hooks: A stabilizer ring destabilizes, threatening citywide resonance.
A Praesertum ritual requires direct Core alignment.
Void‑arcane anomalies manifest near the latticework.
A resonance conduit reports catastrophic overload potential.
